events.text: Bohan accepted a job as an assistant to Edward Molyneux.

events.quote: In 1949 he accepted a job as an assistant to Edward Molyneux .

events.text: Bohan worked as a designer for Madeleine de Rauch.

events.quote: He worked as a designer for Madeleine de Rauch in 1952

events.text: Bohan briefly opened his own Paris salon and produced one collection.

events.quote: before briefly opening his own Paris salon and producing one collection in 1953

events.text: Bohan was offered a job at Jean Patou, designing the haute couture collection.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1954 , Bohan was offered a job at Jean Patou , designing the haute couture collection

events.text: Bohan stayed at Jean Patou until 1958.

events.text: Bohan was appointed for two years as guest-professor for fashion design at the University of Applied Arts Vienna / Austria.

events.quote: In 1991 he was appointed for two years as guest-professor for fashion design at the University of Applied Arts Vienna / Austria
